title: Odd-Polynomial QSVT Singular-Value Equalization on Subset-Sum Fiber Block Encodings
claims: The subset-sum fiber block encoding on occupied residues has singular values sigma_y = sqrt(N_A(y) / N_max) with condition number kappa = sqrt(N_max / N_min).

Degree-1 linear QSVT P_1(sigma) = sigma reproduces P_PGM(A), whereas concave odd QSVT polynomials P_3(sigma) = 0.5*sigma*(3 - sigma^2) and P_5(sigma) = (1/8)*sigma*(15 - 10*sigma^2 + 3*sigma^4) strictly boost post-selected QFT recovery above P_PGM(A) toward the flat-fiber ceiling R(A)/Q.
